scope: Matched one-vCPU 128-MiB Pi4B/KVM observer images, native entry through termination entry; six unchanged original workloads. Separate phase-7 validation does not raise the peak.
method: Replay reserved physical intervals and every native allocation/free; verify metadata, free headers and peak blocks against original snapshots. Matched early/exit captures close boundaries; these are reused runs, not new repetitions.
free_metadata_convention: Count unavailable TLSF block headers, area descriptors, sentinels, aligned control and buddy bitmap/control reservations. Reusable free-block payload (including overlaid free-list links) is not allocated occupancy.

stack_auxiliary.scope: Native entry to allocator registration; included storage, not added to peak
